name: Default
shortDescription: Document question answering platform that parses uploaded files, indexes them for hybrid keyword and vector search, and answers with cited sources through chat, an agent and a generated wiki.

alerts.message: There is no default account and public sign-up is open: register your account right after deploying. To make it the system administrator, set WEKNORA_BOOTSTRAP_SYSTEM_ADMIN_EMAIL to its email and redeploy, then restrict registration in Settings or set DISABLE_REGISTRATION to true.

WeKnora ships no models. Add a chat model and an embedding model from any OpenAI-compatible API when you create the first knowledge base. To use an Ollama server instead, set OLLAMA_BASE_URL to its address (for example http://ollama.example.com:11434) and redeploy.
